pages.text: The cities are not unguarded. The $(thing)Echo Sentinel$() is a floating construct that still keeps watch — it charges and fires a $(o)light-pulse beam$(). It haunts the Undercrown and the vaults.
Defeat one for $(thing)resonance core fragments$(), $(thing)luminite$(), $(thing)memory crystal shards$(), and rarely a $(thing)Lumen Relay$() — the parts you need to rebuild the Lumenwrights' tech.
